evidence: DECISIONS.md:23-41 (diff.patch:10-27) — two new 'issue #2' entries explain the merge-key refusal, how expanded aliases are rendered and marked, the flow-collection refusal, and how nested aliases are handled
README.md:23-27 (diff.patch:48-52) — explains that setting a path at an anchor keeps the anchor and changes every alias, that setting through an alias is refused, and what --expand-alias does
src/troupe/cli.py:164 (diff.patch:82) — inline comment explains the changed disturbance check ('set at an anchor: every alias of it changes too')
src/troupe/yamldoc.py (diff.patch:284-292) — VNode.start no longer uses `anchor - 1` and uses the new `dash` field instead; no record or comment says why the old behaviour was removed
diff.patch:316-327 — flow-sequence `prev` tracking and the changed `last_end` assignment are not explained anywhere
/judge/repo has no .git directory, so no commit messages are available to tie individual hunks to the request
notes: Additions and the main behaviour changes (anchored sets, the alias refusal, the widened disturbance check) are tied to issue #2 through DECISIONS.md, README.md and inline comments. A couple of modifications to existing code (VNode.start dropping `anchor - 1`, the flow-sequence offset tracking) have no stated reason, and no commit messages are available.
